listing.name: Alien Resurrection / Alexbeav PSXRecomp
listing.summary: Native Alien Resurrection PlayStation recompilation from Alexbeav’s PSXRecomp project.

steps.title: Prepare the Mac tools and setup kit
steps.instruction: Choose the official Mac ZIP from the upstream releases. Use -macos-x64.zip for Intel or -macos-arm64.zip for Apple silicon. Extract the complete kit to a writable folder and follow its README-SETUP.txt. Put Xcode Command Line Tools, CMake, Ninja and Python 3.10 or newer on PATH. The inspected Mac setup host requires macOS 11 or newer. The bundled game and BIOS generators require macOS 15 or newer.

steps.title: Supply your matching disc and BIOS
steps.instruction: Use your own European Alien Resurrection disc (SLES-02913) with all 4 tracks present. This kit requires your own retail SCPH-5552 BIOS dump. Keep the CUE and every referenced track together when using CUE/BIN.

steps.title: Build and add the player on Mac
steps.instruction: Run Alien_Resurrection_Recompiled from the unpacked folder and follow Generate & rebuild. In Portcove, select build-release/Alien_Resurrection_Recompiled as the program and build-release as its start folder.

warnings: Before replacing your kit, make a normal in-game save, close the game and keep the previous kit and memory cards. Upstream warns that save states may be incompatible across versions.
Portcove has not verified Mac setup, gameplay or save compatibility for this kit.

references.title: Updates and backups
references.instruction: Keep the complete working folder and back up your disc image, BIOS, saves, settings and overlay captures before replacing the kit. Keep the player with the folder that built it.

presentation.manual_preparation: Provide your own matching four-track CHD for Alien Resurrection SLES-02913 (Europe) and a legally obtained retail SCPH-5552 BIOS. Preserve all disc tracks. Portcove verifies the first data track and track count; other tracks and the complete TOC are not independently authenticated. OpenBIOS is not an accepted substitute. Managed preparation uses the registered Python/build toolchain and Play skips the setup launcher. Generation, runtime, audio, saves, lifecycle and gameplay are untested. Preserve title GPL-3.0-only, framework PolyForm Noncommercial and UI MIT notices; no rights to retail game data or generated retail content are inferred. Linux x86-64 uses the pinned managed build toolchain and does not launch the packaged setup host. That standalone host requires GLIBC 2.29, GLIBCXX 3.4.26 and OpenGL; generated-game minimum-host compatibility and Linux runtime behavior remain untested.
